lead: Moving a gap's owner tag onto the item's last line trades one `owners.py` failure for the next one.
body: The repair two bullets up makes the tag *readable*, and what it then reads is `unowned`, which `--reasons` refuses until `carried-gaps.md` § *Unowned* carries a bullet naming that module's path — so a session that fixed the paragraph placement and stopped leaves the same floor check red for a different reason. Re-run `python tools/owners.py --check --reasons` after the repair, never the bare `--check`, and distrust a handoff that calls the floor green without quoting the tool.
